title: Design System: Aekarut Phetpradit — Colour Chapters

display.purpose: The name (home, footer) and a project title on its page. Archivo 800 at width 66–68%, clamp(64px, 11.6vw, 188px).

headline.purpose: Chapter, station and section titles. Archivo 800 at width 70–72%, clamp(44px, 5.8vw, 92px); long titles take clamp(40px, 4.4vw, 68px).

lead.purpose: The line under a title, the role line, folder tab names. clamp(20px, 1.6vw, 25px).

body.purpose: All running text, full ink of its ground, 18px/1.55.

motion.name: rise
motion.purpose: Title, text, then pictures entering a section, once.

motion.name: chapter-slide
motion.purpose: Each project field slides over the last.

motion.name: page-morph
motion.purpose: The clicked tab, chapter or next band becomes the next opening.

components.name: Folder Tab

components.css: .ds-folder { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 16px; min-height: 58px; padding: 10px 22px; border-radius: 14px 14px 4px 4px; background: #006B6B; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; transition: transform 360ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-folder-name { font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; font-stretch: 86%; } .ds-folder-kind { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-folder:hover, .ds-folder:focus-visible { transform: translateX(10px); } .ds-folder:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #111311; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Open project / Source on GitHub: the field ink as fill, the field as text.
components.html: Open project
components.css: .ds-btn { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; background: #fff; color: #006B6B; font: 700 18px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 260ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: scale(0.97); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #fff; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Pull-request links in a project opening.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 56px; padding: 0 26px; border-radius: 999px; border: 2px solid #fff; color: #fff; background: #8152DB; font: 700 18px/1 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); }

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Wordmark, Projects menu, GitHub; takes the project field on a project page.
components.css: .ds-bar { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center; padding: 14px 32px; background: #F6F6F3; color: #111311; font: 600 18px/1.2 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-bar span { display: flex; gap: 28px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-bar a { color: inherit; text-decoration: none; min-height: 44px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; } .ds-bar a:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 5px; }

components.name: Phone Capture

components.css: .ds-phone { width: 200px; margin: 0; font: 500 15px/1.45 'Archivo Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-phone-screen { aspect-ratio: 390 / 844; border-radius: 26px; background: #E8F1EE; border: 6px solid #0D0F0D; } figcaption { margin-top: 14px; }

narrative.overview:
Each project's own interface colour becomes the field the visitor scrolls through, so the portfolio is as colourful as the work and the colour is never decoration. The nine field colours were sampled from the projects' own captures and adjusted only where text needed 4.5:1.

Redesign decision (2026-10-28, owner's direction board): replace direction. The Three.js night gallery is retired with its models, stage and camera. Kept from v1: real captures as the visual lead, honest captions and credits, one phone width per page, a full reading experience without script or motion.
keyCharacteristics: Paper ground and near-black ink; nine flat fields in the projects' own colours.
One family, Archivo Variable, condensed and heavy for titles, normal width for reading.
Full-screen chapters that pin and slide over each other on large screens.
Captures untinted, uncropped, in matched frames; no lines, rest shadows, gradients or glass.

rules.name: The Own Colour Rule
rules.body: A project's colour comes from its own interface. A new project gets a colour sampled from its captures, checked to 4.5:1 with its text colour, before it gets a chapter.

rules.name: The Name Beside Colour Rule
rules.body: Colour never identifies a project alone: every field carries the project's name.

rules.name: The Two Lines Rule
rules.body: No title wraps past two lines at any width.

dos: **Do** take a new project's colour from its own captures and check it to 4.5:1 with its text colour.
**Do** show captures at their own ratio, untinted, with a caption that says how they were made.
**Do** keep every phone on a page the same width.
**Do** keep each chapter within one screen on desktop, or let it release (`.loose`).
**Do** keep content visible without script and with reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** put a label above a heading; fold the category and credit into the line under it.
**Don't** add lines, rest shadows, gradients, glass or icon cards.
**Don't** set running text in a soft grey; use the full ink of its ground.
**Don't** name a client or marketplace, or add personal details beyond the name, "KMUTT student · Software Developer" and github.com/AokDesu.
**Don't** bring back 3D models, WebGL or a camera ride.
